summary: Native conversations show everything OMP shows: typed views for every OMP tool family and extension record, an irc kind, a conversation header with provenance, and subagent cards that open the child transcript as its own conversation in stui and on the phone.

replay.detail: Views and headers are derived on read from the transcript; no claim replay or projection rebuild is added.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers or migrations change. Conversation content stays volatile and is never stored.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or fleet coordination requirements change.

compatibility.detail: Additive client-v0 fields: optional block view (open view.type), optional entry header, the irc block kind, and session/external-child-... session ids. Clients without conversation-blocks.v1 receive neither blocks nor header and decode as before. Developer-role OMP messages become system text instead of unknown, and entries whose blocks are all internal are hidden by default.

downtime.detail: No migration or recovery wait is added.

manual.detail: No manual action or configuration change is required. Older stui and phone builds keep working and ignore the new fields.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to the previous binary is supported; no stored state changes.
